summary: Level bush-edge kerb on a quiet street, houses 22-28 m opposite, no parked cars.
reasons: Bush reserve on the van's side
No parked cars, so a van stands out

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush reserve behind the north kerb; houses with driveways 22-28 m away across the road, so some are within about 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Open public road with no gate; the verge on the bush side looks narrow and may leave the van partly in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end residential street; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the north kerb in either image; a van would be the only one.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the western start, within 13 m of the kerb
Steep elsewhere: grade reaches about 16% east of 200 m
Slope level at the best section, about 1%
Houses within about 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the north side, mostly from the north and west in the afternoon; road open to the south.
rubbish: Some debris near the road edge around 190-210 m, not at the best section.
cannot_judge: Width of the verge for stopping clear of the lane
Signs beyond the two No Stopping signs

best_section.where: north kerb of Sixth Avenue, just east of the bend where the bush begins
